notes: Add Library Lookup as a top-level module for fast title and UPC/EAN ownership checks.
Add mass UPC/EAN import with duplicate, existing and invalid-code reporting.
Add Check manifests to rebuild/update the searchable database from disc-info.json files, including the has_extras true/false flag.
Add shared UPC/EAN editing in Physical Media so ripping and photo/catalogue workflows use the same barcode value.
Fix the application version metadata used by the release publisher and updater.
